source_title: A Life of Monsters and Hope
author: Robert McMurrer

excerpts.text:
I was doing my training at a nursing home just off the 
base and I was working there when September 11 th 
happened and I was walking around the nursing home while 
all the televisions wa s showing airplanes crashing into the

World Trade Center Towers and at first, I thought it was a 
movie but, later realize it was really happening. 
    That December when my training was done and I was a 
CNA I was offered a job at  the nursing home but, did not 
want a life cleaning bodily fluids and wiping people’s butts 
after they used the bathroom.  I received a plane ticket from 
Job Corp from Indianapolis, Indiana to Phoenix, Arizona 
because I heard David Lawrence McMurrer was living in 
Apache Junction, Arizona but, he did not want me living 
with him.  I found an apartment in Phoenix near the Tempe 
border and was able to get a job at Hawkins Centerpoint 11 
in Tempe, Arizona working as an usher cleaning the theater 
and sometimes tearing the tickets.  I still had a little problem

David McMur rer contacted me in late 2002, which 
shocked me because it sometimes feels like he wishes I did 
not exist but, he contacted me because my younger brother 
was living with him, and he wanted to know if he could 
move in with me in Tempe, Arizona for a short time.  I tried 
to say no but felt guilty in saying yes and he moved in with
no job and no way to help me pay the rent or any bills.
